function.description: Your background helpers (delegate_task background=true) in this session: list them with their state, or stop one by id with cancel.
function.name: delegation_status

cancel.description: A delegation id (deleg_NNNN) of THIS session to stop. A running helper is cancelled; a finished one that has not reported yet never reports. Omit to only list.

reason.description: Why you stop it (kept in the log).
